targets.title: I want to but I won't: Pluralistic ignorance inhibits intentions to take paternity leave in Japan.
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, the present study aimed to directly replicate Study 1 of Miyajima and Yamaguchi (2017).
targets.outcome_quote: As in their study, we found that participants perceived others' attitudes toward paternity leave to be more negative than they actually were, indicating that pluralistic ignorance about paternity leave persists. However, unlike the previous study, the present study did not support Hypothesis 2, which posits that pluralistic ignorance inhibits the willingness to take paternity leave.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm pluralistic ignorance but contrast the failure of its inhibition of willingness with the original. The title singles out inhibition, but the explicit comparison of both tested hypotheses yields mixed.

reasoning: Completed preregistered new-sample replication of Study 1; no additional targets.
